papers.name: SAGE
papers.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI
papers.input: User task + room/robot type; parser infers minimum objects and pick/place/navigate stages.
papers.output: New room shell, object meshes/poses/physical properties, Isaac Sim scenes, augmented scenes and action data.
papers.method: Agent calls floorplan/layout/asset tools; visual and simulator physics critics; task-preserving object/layout augmentation.
papers.evaluation: Paper Sec.4.2/4.2.2 Tables4–5: actual learned-policy rollout; 3 held-out scenes x90 random starts/configs. Test SR pick/place50.0%, mobile manipulation46.0%; planner57.7/52.8%. Pick/place >28k demos264 objects; mobile nearly50k demos50 scenes.
papers.code_scope: Generation client, backend solvers, IsaacLab action/rollout programs and robomimic source present. Selected entry/source inspected; not fully run or complete paper-checkpoint reproduction.
papers.limit: Baselines mimic SceneWeaver/Holodeck components within SAGE, not native repos unified. Shell size generated, minimum objects plus extras; not immutable given shell/exact IDs. Current selected placement detector checks target XY vs table grid and fallback bbox, not full 3D hard-goal conjunction; paper-run equivalence unproven.

papers.name: EmbodiedGenV2
papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.output: Task scene graph with ROBOT/BACKGROUND/CONTEXT/TARGETS/DISTRACTORS; assets/physics/affordances/poses. Additional large-room/multiroom procedural backgrounds.
papers.method: Task parse→sim-ready asset generation→BFS placement with support/collision and robot-reach region→SAPIEN settling; large-room route selects Infinigen room type/complexity then export.
papers.evaluation: Sec.3.3: 150 task worlds, 778 interactive asset instances, manual final acceptance83.3%, 47.7±5.4min/world sequential RTX4090. Sec.3.4 real-robot21.7→75.0% (12scenes240trials) is explicitly summarized from companion study2603.18532, not an independent second robot experiment.
papers.code_scope: Task-driven layout CLI/models and room generation/router/export code public; selected docs/entry/router inspected. No full simulation or cross-engine consistency reproduction.
papers.limit: Acceptance is manual usability, not all-world policy SR. Current room router transmits discrete room/House+complexity, not full task predicates into room solver. Does not fix user shell/exact inventory; USD room export requires PhysicsUSDAdder postprocess per docs.

papers.name: WEDGE
papers.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
papers.input: ObjectNav task, existing policy and logged successes/failures; measurable scene/path features.
papers.output: Repositioned target, new start state or new ProcTHOR layout in diagnosed weak regime; calibrated training episodes.
papers.method: LLM proposes executable weakness features validated statistically; vary relevant environment factor; keep candidate with2–3successful trials in5 frozen-policy rollouts; adapt and rediagnose.
papers.evaluation: Sec.4 Table1: Uni-NaVid ProcTHOR SR51.6→55.7; held-out HM3D69.2→73.4 aftertwo rounds. DD-PPO82.1→85.6 ProcTHOR. Matched adaptation budgets vs random/hard-mined; measured SR/SPL. Different agents use RL/finetuning/ICL, not one identical training algorithm.
papers.code_scope: Official repo public80tree entries: weakness-discovery Python and logged episode corpora. README and full tree inspected; generation/adaptation implementation not present among public source files.
papers.limit: Actual policy-conditioned curriculum already exists. Only indoor ObjectNav; no manipulation/fixedinventory guarantee. Training filter2–3/5 is deliberate curriculum selection, not generator acceptance SR; retain candidate counts/cost separately.

papers.code_scope: Paper/author-publication link verified. No author-linked code/dataset URL established from paperHTML, authorpage and targetedqueries asof2026-10-26; paper release claims remain unverified.
papers.limit: ED20k vsP10k comparison differs in corpus count; use equal10k ablation for isolate scale. Precise benchmark transfer adapter/metric thresholds unavailable for source audit. Short10–50step tasks, single-agent, no fluids/deformables. Do not turn release claim into verified GitHub availability.
